name: statAssemblyPipeline
description: How player stats are assembled from server data before battle — setPlayerList and its sub-functions
overview: Called during battle initialization. Takes server-provided player data and constructs a fully-initialized Unit with all attributes, equipment visuals, pets, skills, spirits, and passive skills.

parameters.t: Player data from server (contains attr_list, figure, pet_list, role_skill, ext, etc.)
parameters.i: Team role object (gets units pushed to it)

steps.description: Get job and unit config
steps.note: Job figure → model ID → ConfigUnit (97 fields, 77 XOR-obfuscated)

steps.description: Initialize unit and set basic info
steps.details: Creates new unit, sets config, name, level, head, roleId

steps.description: Set player attributes
Set equipment visuals and idle animation
Process attr_obj_list for pet/skill attribute objects
steps.details: Parses attr_obj_list into groups: group 1 = pet attributes, group 2 = skill attributes. Each has sub-keys (k=pet_id or skill_id) mapping to attribute values.

steps.description: Set player pets
Store skill attribute info and set skills
Process ext (extension) data
steps.details: ext is an array of {k, v} pairs with various effects

ext_keys.2: Set HP as percentage: currenHp = roundInt(round(max(1, value) / 10000) * maxHP)
ext_keys.4: Set HP as absolute: currenHp = roundInt(max(1, min(value, maxHP)))

steps.description: Set spirit data
Set passive skills with angel skill enhancements

setPlayerAttrib.description: Initialize all module=1 attributes from ConfigAttribute with base values from server

steps.description: Get all attributes where module=1 from ConfigAttribute
Get chapter type config for PvE filtering
For each attribute, create MetaAttrib and set baseValue
steps.formula: metaAttrib = new MetaAttrib(configAttribute); metaAttrib.baseValue = getAttrib(attr.id, player.attr_list)
steps.special_case: If chapterConfig.pve == 0 AND attr is pve_dam(1057) or pve_resist(1058), baseValue is forced to 0

setPlayerAttrib.note: attr_list is an array of {k: attribId, v: value} from the server. getAttrib searches this list by key and returns roundInt(Number(v)), or 0 if not found.

setPlayerEquip.description: Process equipment figure data for visual appearance
special_rules: In Team20, WorldBoss, or DoubleLadder chapter types: fate slot is forced to 0
If artifact_figure > 0: weapon slot uses artifact_figure instead
Skin system: skin_list with k=2 applies dress skin, only_skin=1 hides ALL slots, only_skin=2 hides weapon only, only_skin=3 hides ornaments+face

steps.description: For each pet in pet_list with pet_id != 0
steps.code: petConfig = configPet.getDataByKey(pet_id); petLevel = configPetlevel.getDataByKeys('id', pet_id, 'level', pet_lev)

steps.description: Create new unit with pet's unitId from ConfigUnit
For each module=1 attribute, set base value using getPetFactAttrValue
Override key stats from parent player
steps.note: Pals inherit parent's HP, ATK, partner_dam_extra, skill_dam_extra, skill_crit_rate, skill_crit_dam, and boss_dam

steps.description: Set idle index and add to team

getPetFactAttrValue.description: Apply pet attribute bonuses with group-based multiplicative scaling

formula_steps.description: Calculate additive bonus: pet-specific + global pet bonus
formula_steps.formula: value = roundInt(baseValue + getPetAttrByAttrId(petAttrs, petId, attrId) + getPetAttrByAttrId(petAttrs, 0, attrId))
formula_steps.note: petId=0 means global bonus applying to all pets

formula_steps.description: Get attributes in same group from ConfigAttribute
For each attribute in the group, apply multiplicative bonus
formula_steps.formula: groupBonus = roundInt(getPetAttrByAttrId(petAttrs, petId, groupAttr.id) + getPetAttrByAttrId(petAttrs, 0, groupAttr.id)); multiplier = round(round(groupBonus / 10000) + 1); value = roundInt(value * multiplier)
formula_steps.note: Group bonuses are percentage-based (divided by 10000) and multiplicative with each other

steps.description: Get avian config and unit config
For each module=1 attribute, set base value from unit config
steps.note: Avian stats come directly from ConfigUnit fields (XOR-obfuscated)

steps.description: Set idle index to 8 (avian position) and add to team

setPlayerSkill.description: Load active skills sorted by position

steps.description: Get active skills from player data
Sort by pos_id ascending
For each skill with skill_id > 0, add to unit
steps.code: skill = addSkill(unit, skill_id, skill_lv); skill.useDelay = round(delay_time / 1000)
steps.note: delay_time converts from milliseconds to seconds

setPlayerPassiveSkill.description: Load passive skills with chapter type filtering and angel skill enhancements

steps.description: For each passive skill with skill_id > 0
Check if skill is valid for current chapter type
steps.note: Skills can be restricted to specific PvP/PvE modes via chapter_type array

steps.description: If angel skill enhancement data matches this passive skill

setPlayerPassiveSkill.note: Angel skills enhance passive skills by adding extra skill effects and damage parameters

setSkillEffect.description: Apply angel skill effects to a skill

checkPvpChapterTypeOk.description: Check if a skill is valid for the current chapter/PvP type

logic.no_chapter_type: If chapter_type is null/empty, skill is always valid
logic.if_chapter_type_0: Normal mode: skill valid if current chapter type is in the list
logic.if_chapter_type_1: Inverse mode: skill valid if current chapter type is NOT in the list
